3293|5bfb096f.name: Rezlak
3293|5bfb096f.text: I'm happy Gazlowe gave me the opportunity to be here and all, but this place is more dangerous than I thought it'd be. It's also really hot. And dusty. And it smells kinda weird. Ah, well! Hopefully it will be good for business.

6082-progress.name: Thotar
6082-progress.text: Were you able to tame the scorpid?
6082-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6083-progress.name: Thotar
6083-progress.text: You need to practice in order to gain the skills you need to effectively control your pet. Have you tamed a surf crawler?
6083-progress.title: Taming the Beast

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

96655-complete.name: Cook Torka
96655-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96655-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96821-complete.name: Gar'Thok
96821-complete.text: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
96821-complete.title: Legging It

96822-accept.name: Turroc
96822-accept.text:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822-accept.title: For Honor

96822-complete.name: Turroc
96822-complete.text: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
96822-complete.title: For Honor

96822-progress.name: Turroc
96822-progress.text: Have you done what I asked?
96822-progress.title: For Honor

96825-accept.name: Cook Torka
96825-accept.text:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825-accept.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96825-complete.name: Cook Torka
96825-complete.text: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
96825-complete.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

97225-complete.name: Master Gadrin
97225-complete.text:
You have done a great deed for our tribe today.

Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.

I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
97225-complete.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97225-progress.name: Master Gadrin
97225-progress.text: Have you found our loa idols, $N? We must begin our rituals again soon.
97225-progress.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97281-accept.name: Unknown
97281-accept.text:
<Before you is a strange orb and with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281-accept.title: A Simmering Storm

97281-complete.name: Rezlak
97281-complete.text: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...
97281-complete.title: A Simmering Storm

97282-accept.name: Rezlak
97282-accept.text:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity come's knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282-accept.title: Stormy Potential

97282-complete.name: Rezlak
97282-complete.text:
Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.

Here's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.

Either way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.
97282-complete.title: Stormy Potential

97282-progress.name: Rezlak
97282-progress.text:
It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.

Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.

Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
97282-progress.title: Stormy Potential

97903-accept.name: Brakk
97903-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97903-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97903-complete.name: Rawrk
97903-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97903-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97908-complete.name: Thuwd
97908-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97908-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning
